jobs.title: Strategy - Future Leaders Graduate Program
jobs.description: Kurz und knapp Du kommst frisch aus dem Studium und bist bereit, direkt ins Herz unseres Businesses einzusteigen? Komplexe Challenges schrecken dich nicht ab - sondern motivieren dich erst recht? Dann gehörst du ins Consumer Team von Picnic. Unser 1-jähriges Trainee Programm ist kein Warm-up, sondern dein echtes Launchpad. Du startest direkt ohne Rotation in einer Consumer-Rolle - ob Category Management, Store, Meals oder Customer, je nachdem wo deine Stärken und Interessen liegen. Ab Tag eins arbeitest du mit echten Daten, übernimmst Verantwortung und treibst Projekte voran, die sichtbar Impact haben. Parallel dazu investieren wir gezielt in dich: mit Trainings zu Marktverständnis, Business-Knowledge und Präsentations-Skills. Und weil Erfolg gemeinsam mehr Spaß macht, wirst du Teil einer eng vernetzten Graduate-Community - smart, ambitioniert und immer bereit, Dinge neu zu denken. Kurz gesagt: Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern deinen Berufseinstieg aktiv mitgestalten willst - Welcome to Picnic!  Das erwartet dich Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit unseren Category Managern, Designern, Copywritern und Tech-Teams bringst du alle Köpfe an einen Tisch. Das Ergebnis: ein App-Erlebnis, das nicht nur reibungslos funktioniert, sondern unsere Kunden begeistert. Analyse: Zahlen sind dein Kompass. Aus Kundenverhalten leitest du smarte Insights ab, verbesserst App-Features, schärfst unser Pricing und entwickelst Aktionen, die einfach überzeugen. Innovation : Du denkst einen Schritt weiter. Trends und Kundenbedürfnisse erkennst du früh und sorgst dafür, dass sich unser Sortiment ständig weiterentwickelt. Optimierung: Mit einem Blick fürs Detail entwickelst du Tools und Prozesse, die unsere kommerziellen Aktivitäten effizienter, präziser und wirkungsvoller machen. Projekte: Du steuerst cross-funktionale Projekte - von Marketing über Customer Experience bis hin zu Operational Excellence. Immer mit dem Ziel, Wachstum voranzutreiben und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen.&n

Mit über 3.000 EPVs (Electric Picnic Vehicle) liefern wir in über 100 deutschen Städten täglich Lebensmittel aus. Unsere jüngste Investment Runde, an der auch die Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation beteiligt ist, zeigt das Vertrauen in unser Konzept. Als Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d) in unserem FC in Falkensee spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Zufriedenheit unserer KundInnen und Mitarbeitenden. Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen. jobs.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Kurz und knapp Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Nürnberg bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der  Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas. Das erwartet dich  Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 4 Teamleitenden und über 50 Lagermitarbeitenden. Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht. Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (3–4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1–2 Tage pro Woche). Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand. jobs.title: Commercial - Future Leaders Graduate Program
jobs.description: Kurz und knapp Du kommst frisch aus dem Studium und bist bereit, direkt ins Herz unseres Businesses einzusteigen? Komplexe Challenges schrecken dich nicht ab - sondern motivieren dich erst recht? Dann gehörst du ins Consumer Team von Picnic. Unser 1-jähriges Trainee Programm ist kein Warm-up, sondern dein echtes Launchpad. Du startest direkt ohne Rotation in einer Consumer-Rolle - ob Category Management, Store, Meals oder Customer, je nachdem wo deine Stärken und Interessen liegen. Ab Tag eins arbeitest du mit echten Daten, übernimmst Verantwortung und treibst Projekte voran, die sichtbar Impact haben. Parallel dazu investieren wir gezielt in dich: mit Trainings zu Marktverständnis, Business-Knowledge und Präsentations-Skills. Und weil Erfolg gemeinsam mehr Spaß macht, wirst du Teil einer eng vernetzten Graduate-Community - smart, ambitioniert und immer bereit, Dinge neu zu denken. Kurz gesagt: Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern deinen Berufseinstieg aktiv mitgestalten willst - Welcome to Picnic!  Das erwartet dich Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit unseren Category Managern, Designern, Copywritern und Tech-Teams bringst du alle Köpfe an einen Tisch. Das Ergebnis: ein App-Erlebnis, das nicht nur reibungslos funktioniert, sondern unsere Kunden begeistert. Analyse: Zahlen sind dein Kompass. Aus Kundenverhalten leitest du smarte Insights ab, verbesserst App-Features, schärfst unser Pricing und entwickelst Aktionen, die einfach überzeugen. Innovation : Du denkst einen Schritt weiter. Trends und Kundenbedürfnisse erkennst du früh und sorgst dafür, dass sich unser Sortiment ständig weiterentwickelt. Optimierung: Mit einem Blick fürs Detail entwickelst du Tools und Prozesse, die unsere kommerziellen Aktivitäten effizienter, präziser und wirkungsvoller machen. Projekte: Du steuerst cross-funktionale Projekte - von Marketing über Customer Experience bis hin zu Operational Excellence. Immer mit dem Ziel, Wachstum voranzutreiben und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen.&n

The role is remote, employed through an IonQ entity in the UK (Oxford) or Switzerland, with travel of up to 20%. jobs.description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! What you’ll be doing Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time. jobs.title: Head of KYC  - CDI (F/H)
jobs.description: Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne. Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds. Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés. Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund. Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable. Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement) Télétravail : Jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (au choix) LE POSTE Le/la Head of KYC Operations est un acteur clé dans la mise en œuvre du système de lutte contre la criminalité financière de l’entreprise et de notre approche centrée sur le client : une véritable opportunité de relever de nouveaux défis au sein d’une FinTech à taille humaine, évoluant dans un cadre réglementaire en perpétuelle évolution. Rattaché(e) au VP AML au sein du Département Conformité et Risques, en tant que manager opérationnel KYC, vous superviserez le cadre de gestion KYC de Lemonway. jobs.description: Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io . We're looking for a staff product engineer — not a generalist who happens to touch frontend and backend, but someone who thinks like a product owner and ships like an engineer. About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence. What We Value End-to-end ownership You take on the problems nobody's claimed — the ones that span squads with no obvious owner — and carry them from a fuzzy first conversation to what's actually live. If it touches the customer, it's yours to chase down. Comfort in ambiguity Half-formed problems and conflicting signals are your starting material, not a blocker. You define the problem before you solve it, form a point of view on what's worth building, and move without waiting for someone else to de-risk the call. Customer-first, always You think from the customer's problem backward, not the codebase forward. Every technical call traces back to what it does for the person on the other end of the message — and you can explain that connection to people who don't write code. Given the choice, you ship the thing that changes their experience, not the thing that's merely elegant. A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done" You retire practices that have outlived their usefulness, including ones you helped build. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion. Force multiplication Shipping your part isn't the bar. You bring in the right people before a problem becomes theirs to clean up, and you leave enough behind — docs, patterns, delegation — that the team keeps moving without you in the room. jobs.description: About the Project Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. The recordings produced help build natural, everyday-sounding synthesized voices for conversational AI products — voices that sound like real people talking, not scripted performances. As Session Director, you'll lead live recording sessions with Voice Contributors, guiding them through scripted scenarios to produce natural, conversational-quality audio. This hands-on role blends creative direction, coaching, and technical audio judgment — making scripted material sound authentic and unscripted, rather than recited, while keeping sessions moving at a natural pace. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Brightline is redefining what pediatric behavioral health care looks like for families across the country, and we're looking for the Senior Product Manager who will bring that vision to life. This role owns product direction and delivery for a defined area, starting with clinical operations, internal tools, and partner integrations. You'll take on important business problems, work closely with Engineering, Design, Clinical, Operations, Growth, and Data, and be accountable for the outcomes in the area you own. Why This Role Every hour a clinician spends working around a clunky process is an hour they aren't spending with a family. This role starts there: improving how our clinical and operations teams work and how our systems connect with partners, so our teams can serve more families without adding unnecessary work or cost. Over time, your scope may grow to include the member and caregiver experience, engagement, and growth. We want someone who can figure out which problems are worth solving, make practical tradeoffs, and measure whether the solutions are working. Experience using AI and automation to improve workflows is important, but the outcome matters more than the technology. In this role, you will report to the Director of Payments and touch all aspects of Taptap Send's payment operations, with an initial focus on stablecoin funding, working directly with our teams and partners across the world. You'll own the full life cycle of payments, including creating, tracking and confirming crediting of funds, as well as troubleshooting payment issues across our growing Stablecoin operations. You'll also be involved in funding forecasts to ensure that our partners are well funded at all times. You'll work directly with our trading team as well as collaborating with the wider team that spans the globe ( London, Abidjan, Lagos, Nairobi, Paris and New York, to name a few places), ensuring that Taptap Send is effectively supported in its growth and customer ambitions! There is plenty of room for professional progression and personal growth within our friendly and ever-growing Taptap community. Responsibilities Proactively managing treasury operations, initially for stablecoins, to ensure our accounts are funded and payments can be processed seamlessly Working closely with partners to ensure that funding timelines are being delivered on time Troubleshooting to find root causes of payment issues and working with internal and external partners to resolve Assisting with onboarding new banks and trading partners for stablecoin, working closely with our business development team Providing out-of-hours coverage when required Requirements Have at least 1 years’ experience, ideally in a payments or funding role and/or working with stablecoins Are passionate about our mission and eager to do what needs to be done to achieve it Are enthusiastic about treasury operations, solving unique problems, and optimizing processes Enjoy challenges, are resourceful and think outside the box to find creative ways to tackle problems Lov

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”? Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite. Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents . We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work. The job You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly. Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle. Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once. Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks. Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves. Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents. Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups. Why you’ll want it Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready. Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers. Don't get boxed in. Own the repo

jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description: The Role India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market. You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it. As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels. Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO What You'll Own The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win. Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it. Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corri

jobs.description: Head of Partnerships (Africa) Spending time in a hub location (London, Dubai, Paris, or New York) and Africa (50%+) Shape the future of Africa’s financial landscape while building your legacy. This is your chance to lead business strategy, build powerful commercial relationships and directly drive positive outcomes for the continent and diaspora communities around the world. You’ll have the freedom to trust your own instincts, make connections across Africa, and pursue commercial deals where your gut tells you opportunity exists. You’ll be trusted to know what’s best, to represent the business at senior levels, and to lead on some of our most critical relationships in the region. Work for the market-leading emerging markets FinTech, with a genuine mission to support Africa's development by driving capital into the continent over the long term. What you’ll do As well as owning the relationship with existing partners in Africa, you'll constantly be identifying new partners and stakeholders in Africa, directly building relationships with them. You’ll negotiate great deals and oversee the process from first meeting to go-live. Working with regulators and policy makers across the region, you’ll represent the Taptap Send brand externally, personifying competence and instilling confidence through all of your interactions. Understanding everything that’s going on in your markets through the tracking, analysis, and reporting of key metrics will be key. You’ll also work with other members of the Growth team to develop and share best practices. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Business Development, and Engineering teams to ensure Taptap Send has the best product offering in the market, being the internal voice of the region. We’re looking for a versatile, persistent product engineer who’s not afraid to set up reusable building blocks across the stack and advocate for the time and space to do so. At Ashby, all our engineers ship features end-to-end at a high pace. Example is the best leadership. We’ll give you the room to do your best work, and you'll be our guide! If that speaks to you, read on. What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: 100,000+ weekly active users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature. We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet. You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double Engineering this year). About the Role and How We Work Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks. They look at measuring our risk, optimising our credit risk funnel and forecasting the performance of our loan portfolios. To do this, they work with the credit risk modelling, engineering, data management, capital markets and business operations teams to truly understand our objectives and shape analytical solutions. Focusing on our Credit Risk lending capabilities, you’ll be given the opportunity to think outside the box and come up with a wide range of suggestions and ideas to optimise our ability to lend to small businesses, while also delivering strong returns for our investors. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Financial Experience
jobs.description: We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Financial Experience (FinXP), the team that builds how practices and patients deal with money at Nelly. That covers how a patient says yes to a treatment they can’t pay for upfront, and how delivered care becomes an invoice, then a payment, then cash in the practice’s account. You’ll lead a team whose work shows up directly in what practices earn and in what Nelly earns. The problem space: Practices rarely lose revenue because care isn’t needed. They lose it at two points. Before treatment, patients delay or decline because they can’t pay upfront. After treatment, revenue leaks on its way to cash: invoices go out late or wrong, payments get chased by hand, and billing runs through manual steps. The domain Financial OS closes both gaps. We offer financing at the moment the patient decides, through installment plans and factoring, and we turn every delivered treatment into a correct invoice and cash in the practice’s account. Because we sit where treatment is planned, we know what it’s worth and whether it is converted before we take on the risk, which no bank or payment provider can do. We earn a share of the revenue we help collect, so the practice’s growth is our growth. The domain has two teams. Financial Platform builds the infrastructure that moves money and keeps compliant records of it. Financial Experience builds everything doctors, practice staff, patients and our own teams touch, across the Doctor Portal, Patient Portal and Backoffice. About Nelly We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. jobs.title: Pentester Senior / Red Team
jobs.description: Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI. Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence. Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux. Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles. Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe. Nos valeurs Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler. 1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents. 2. Chacun fait la différence Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse. Le poste Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team. Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage tech

Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists. Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e. jobs.description: Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL s portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.   Position Purpose The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams

jobs.description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. *Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers. About the role This role is based in our San Francisco office and is also open to remote candidates in the US. We're hiring an Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager to build and run the programs that fill our pipeline. You'll own campaigns across paid media, webinars, account-based marketing, and social, from strategy through launch and optimization. This is a builder role. You'll stand up programs that don't exist yet, ship them quickly, and scale what works. You'll partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Design and RevOps to turn target accounts into qualified pipeline. Je bent een van de eerste aanspreekpunten voor bezoekers en bellers en leert hoe je hen vriendelijk en professioneel helpt. Je ontvangt gasten bij de receptie, neemt de telefoon op en voert verschillende administratieve werkzaamheden uit. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld met de administratie rondom zakelijke reizen, het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens en, waar mogelijk, het boeken van hotels en vluchten. jobs.title: Product Manager - Post Booking
jobs.description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip. BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions. In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions. Your Mission As the Product Manager for Post-booking, you will shape the experience passengers have after making a booking, from managing their trips to getting the help they need before, during and after their journey. You will make post-booking a clear, reliable and useful part of the end-to-end BlaBlaCar experience across carpooling, bus and train. You will help passengers feel informed and in control, while reducing friction for our Customer Relationship Teams (CRT) and supporting the growth of our multimodal marketplace. You will co-lead the Post-booking squad with an Engineering Manager and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Relationship and our supply stakeholders. Your Responsibilities Shape the post-booking vision and roadmap: Set a clear direction for the passenger experience after purchase, translating BlaBlaCar’s product strategy and business priorities into a focused roadmap. jobs.description: Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. jobs.title: STAGE Fullstack  - Time-Travel debugger pour architecture événementielle (H/F)
jobs.description: Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique. Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ? Techniquement, Winamax c’est : Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience Contexte Notre plateforme de jeu repose sur des microservices stateless : chaque traitement est une fonction pure appliquée à un message et à un état. Sur le papier, c'est le rêve pour débugger. En pratique, l'outillage n'existe pas, et CloudWatch devient vite chronophage dès qu'il faut analyser les interactions entre services. Comment rejouer les messages et les changements d'états pour reproduire un dysfonctionnement à l'identique ? Objectifs du stage Concevoir et déployer un outil réellement opérationnel, en trois briques : Ingestion et indexation à l'échelle : capter les messages et les transitions d'états, définir un modèle de stockage scalable sans impacter la production Générateur de tests local : isoler une séquence, reconstruire l'arbre d'états, et en sortir des tests de non-régression automatisés Replayer : une API et un back-office minimaliste pour visualiser graphiquement les états et les interactions inter-services Les points d'attention : la volumétrie, la fidélité de la reconstruction chronologique, la corrélation d'événements en environne

jobs.title: Stage consultancy in de Zorg, onderwijs en sociaal domein
jobs.description: 0,8 -1fte uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Zorg en maatschappelijke ontwikkeling| € 600,- Wo Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Wil jij je master-afstudeeronderzoek combineren met praktijkervaring bij een toonaangevend adviesbureau? En wil je bijdragen aan actuele ontwikkelingen in de zorg, het onderwijs of het sociaal domein? Lees dan verder. Voor onze adviesgroep Zorg en Maatschappelijke Ontwikkeling (ZMO) zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en gedreven stagiair voor de periode februari tot en met juni 2027. Je werkt drie dagen per week mee aan adviesopdrachten en besteedt de overige twee dagen aan je afstudeeronderzoek. Tijdens je stage werk je drie dagen samen met ervaren adviseurs en lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan lopende opdrachten. Zo maak je kennis met het adviesvak en ontwikkel je jouw onderzoeks- en adviesvaardigheden. Onze opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, gemeenten, zorgaanbieders en onderwijsinstellingen. We helpen hen bij uiteenlopende vraagstukken zoals de organisatie en betaalbaarheid van zorg, de toekomst van het onderwijs en passende ondersteuning voor inwoners. De rode draad in onze opdrachten is dat ze maatschappelijk urgent en bestuurlijk complex zijn. Naast het meewerken aan adviesopdrachten is er ruimte om aan je scriptie te werken. Voor je afstudeeronderzoek draag je zelf een relevant onderwerp aan. jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.
